fn drain(control: &mut Consumer<Record>) {
    let available: usize = control.available_at_entry();
    for _ in 0..available {
        let Ok(record) = control.try_pop() else {
            break;
        };
        apply(record);
    }
    for _ in 0..control.available_at_entry() {
        let Ok(record) = control.try_pop() else {
            break;
        };
        apply(record);
    }
}
